status: Independent cancel-card architecture/UI audit: changes required. No library or product acceptance.
scope: New cancel_card.rs and launch_dialog_plate cancel wiring, with adjacent application layer/update selectors needed to assess behavior. No approval of other incoming Button/theme/Showcase code or later remote commits.

findings.title: Replace the procedural CANCEL transcription with the real shared dialog and buttons
findings.evidence: The only public operation is paint(Ui,title,body,keep,cancel): no Id, state, update, measure or typed action. It paints Keep focus at a fixed coordinate regardless of Runtime focus and draws both action labels/mnemonics without registering a control. Public consumer probes show visible labels/gutter, no registered regions, focusNone and no focus/visual change after Tab/Right. Empty action labels still leave the focus glyph. Old plate geometry, palette and character positions are directly transcribed; the issue is the mechanism, not its module name or a legitimate default width54.
findings.owner: Existing termrock-overlays Dialog/Action/DialogState with shared termrock-controls Button and layout/state/theme contracts. Consume the separately owned generic Dialog adapter; no new independent input or rendering system.

findings.title: Keep the real cancel layer rendered so Cancel launch dispatches the confirm action
findings.qualification: The frame40 layer suppression is inherited and retained by the new cancel-card call; it was not first introduced by c851.
findings.evidence: Across24 real App cases (frames40/41 ×120x40/119x40/80x24 ×4profiles), all12 frame40 cases expose no action bounds/hit/focus. Clicking the painted Cancel launch dismisses the modal but keeps routeCockpit and launchSome: it behaves as cancellation/dismissal of the dialog rather than ActionKey::CONFIRM. Tab then Enter leaves the confirmation open. At frame41 actual shared controls dispatch to Manager/launchNone for both pointer Cancel and Tab/Enter. Frozen Cockpit uses shared Dialog::destructive(...).cancel_label(Keep launching), with safe-action initial focus and a real destructive action.
findings.owner: App screen composition must always draw the same Dialog in ui.layer using the same IDs/configuration as update. App keeps the ActionKey::CONFIRM domain handler; component owns hit/focus/activation/dismissal. Remove launch_dialog_on_page/frame40/exact-viewport implementation selection with the validated replacement.

findings.title: Use shared grapheme/cell-width wrapping and clip all content to the dialog body
findings.evidence: paint_mnemonic splits the first Unicode scalar and allocates1 cell; label界Keep loses the leading wide glyph. paint_at measures scalar counts and clips only to the page, so100-character title/body words overwrite the card border atx86 and backgroundx87. The private split_whitespace wrapper collapses explicit first\nsecond into first second, unlike frozen shared wrap(s) which preserves paragraphs. Only3 body lines are drawn, with no scrolling state or route to the tail.
findings.owner: Existing Dialog measured body/action layout plus termrock-text grapheme/cell-width/wrap/truncate and shared scroll/clip contracts. Use a resolved body area and real Buttons, not another custom mnemonic/text painter.

findings.title: Remove application repainting and RGB-role inference after the shared cancel painter
findings.evidence: paint_cancel invokes shared cancel_card::paint then immediately recolor(ui,54,11,1). The helper maps raw card RGB, infers screen rain by foreground/background pairs, branches on16/mono/NO_COLOR and dims afterward. The component itself emits fixed RGB focus/danger/card values despite custom accent/danger/surface tokens under all4 profiles. These observations are at public Runtime buffer/API level, not a claim that final encoded CLI frames were compared.
findings.owner: Shared Dialog/Button/theme state and capability profiles. Remove app-owned corrective painting and raw-pair inference; do not rename or move the inference into another library helper.

matching_details: 54x11 card, centred with y_bias1; header close atx50, titlex3/y2, bodyx3/y4..6.

frozen_contract.cockpit: src/bin/jackin_preview/screens/cockpit.rs:451 builds a shared destructive Dialog with the exact launch title/body/Cancel launch and Keep launching label.
frozen_contract.dialog: src/widgets/dialog.rs:403 supplies real secondary/danger Buttons, initial focus on cancel/safe action, Dismiss::LIGHT, measured body rows, shared scroll and ButtonRow wrapping. Button keyboard/pointer activation returns typed action results; text/theme/layout come from shared rules.

retain_separately: Pass application title/body/action copy as borrowed data; keep launch models and business actions outside Termrock.
The exact default title/body/Keep launching/Cancel launch match frozen domain copy and should remain app-owned configuration.

Removing the literal CANCEL cell array is useful cleanup, but not evidence that the mechanism or library gate is complete. Use one cockpit_cancel_dialog configuration for both update and draw rather than duplicate literal argument sets.

replacement_owner_plan.owner: Existing Dialog/Action/DialogState and shared Button/theme/layout contracts
replacement_owner_plan.work: Complete the separately owned generic baseline Dialog adapter, including body-title placement and measured width/height/action rows where required. Safe Keep action initially focuses a real control; hover, press, mnemonics, keyboard navigation, dismissal and destructive confirm use the same action path. Do not create an application/test-named frame variant.

Always render cockpit_cancel_dialog through the real modal layer and same config used for update. Keep CONFIRM cancellation and CANCEL keep-launching outcomes in App. Remove cancel_card painter, page-layer suppression and cancel afterpaint recolor once affected exact paired flows pass.

Run frozen/candidate real CLI pairs for actual Cancel vs Keep/Close/Escape/outside clicks, Tab/ShiftTab/arrows/mnemonics/Enter, hover/press/capture, focus restoration, resize and repeated cycles. Cover frames39/40/41, adjacent sizes, all4 profiles, different/Unicode labels, long/multiline body and empty/tiny regions. Demonstrate the same shared Dialog with unrelated data.

additional_observation.where: All observed frame41 successful destructive-pointer confirmations.
additional_observation.qualification: Observed and preserved; not diagnosed as a new cancel_card regression. The App closes the layer and disables its dialog-update branch in the CONFIRM handler, but this audit does not claim a proven receipt-lifecycle cause or prescribe a source fix. Record a separate App/Dialog/runtime owner diagnosis before calling that control path fully green.

corrected_public_diagnostic_probes.interpretation: These diagnostic tests confirm reported flaws; PASS is not product success.
